scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
I await for the master
whom destiny will choose
for me. Do you think you
have to courage and strength
to conquer this stronghold?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我在等待命运为我选定的主人。
您有勇气和力量征服这座要塞吗？

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Hmpf. Your threats don't
scare me! Guardians, drive
this infidel away from here!
I will always be loyal to the
master of this stronghold,
the one and only ^FF0000{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
哼，你的威胁吓不倒我！
守卫，把这个异教徒赶出去！
我永远只效忠这座要塞的主人，^FF0000{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Ah, Master ^FF0000{0}^000000...
How shall I serve you today?
Was there an aspect of this
stronghold's maintenance
you wanted to discuss?

[管家]
啊，主人^FF0000{0}^000000...
今天有什么可以为您效劳？

Raising the stronghold's
commercial growth will
increase the quantity of
goods produced for the guild.
Investing in commercial growth
will help the guild's future.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
提升要塞的商业发展等级，可以增加公会的物资产量。
这方面的投资有利于公会的长远发展。

[ Steward ]
You can make one investment
each day, but if you can make
two investments if you pay
more Zeny: this will speed
up commercial development,
but can be quite expensive.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
每天可以投资一次，若支付更多Zeny，就能投资两次。
这样可以加快商业发展，但花费也会高得多。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
However, our stronghold's
commerical growth level is
at 100%. It's not possible to
develop commercial growth
any further than that.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
不过，要塞的商业发展已达到100%，无法继续提升。

investments today, so you'll
have to wait until tomorrow
to make another investment.

Zeny to make an investment
for the guild today.

funds, Master. We can expect
to see the results of this
investment by tomorrow.

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
As you command, Master.

[管家]

durability of our Guardians
and the Emperium. We'll need
every advantage to protect
ourselves from our enemies.

[ Steward ]

once per day, but if you pay
more Zeny, you can invest
a maximum of two times daily.

stronghold is 100%, and

the Kafra Employee that

Master, please reconsider!
I've been working very hard
for the success of the guild!
I'll try harder to serve the
guild members of this
stronghold, I promise!

主人，请再考虑一下！
为了公会，我一直在努力工作！
我保证会更加用心地为要塞里的公会成员服务！

scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.translation: 取消

[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
Why?! What have I done
to deserve this? Waaah~!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉 职员]
为什么？！我到底做错了什么，要这样对我？
呜哇~！

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
Thank you, Master!
I'll obey your every
command as best I can!
You won't regret this!
scripts.translation:

谢谢您，主人！
我一定尽力完成您的每一道吩咐！
您不会后悔的！

in my opinion. It was in
all of our best interests to
allow her to stay with us.
scripts.translation:
[管家]

has been dismissed.

by the quality of her service?

[管家]

[ Steward ]
Will you hire a
Kafra Employee to serve
our stronghold? You must
pay ^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000 to hire one.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您要雇佣一名卡普拉职员，为要塞提供服务吗？

scripts.translation: 取消

[ Steward ]
Master, we cannot hire a
Kafra Employee because
you have not yet attained
the ^FF0000Contract with Kafra^000000
guild skill.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
主人，您尚未习得公会技能^FF0000和卡普拉订契约^000000，因此无法雇佣卡普拉职员。

Kafra Employee because
we do not have enough
funds to pay the contract fee.

a contract with the Kafra
Head Office, and hired a
Kafra Employee for our
stronghold. Here she is~

好的，我们已与卡普拉总部签订契约，为要塞雇佣了一名职员。

How do you do? I've
been dispatched by the
Kafra Head Office to
serve your guild's needs.
I'll do my best to follow
your every command, Master.
scripts.translation:

您好，我是卡普拉总部派来为贵公会服务的职员。

after one month, so we must
pay additional fees to keep
this Kafra Employee in
the service of our guild.

[管家]

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
As you command, Master.
However, I suggest hiring
a Kafra Employee as soon
as possible since our guild
would greatly benefit from
the convenient Kafra services.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
遵命，主人。
不过，我建议尽快雇佣一名卡普拉职员，她提供的便捷服务会对公会大有帮助。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Do you wish to enter the
Guild Treasure Room?
Only you, the Guild Master,
are permitted to enter.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您要进入公会宝库吗？
只有您这位公会会长才有权进入。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Please remember to open
the Treasure Boxes at the
proper time. Otherwise, the
treasure may disappear if
something unexpected happens.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
请及时打开宝箱。

on the secret path to
the Treasure Room.
Press the secret switch
when you wish to return here.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我来带您走通往宝库的秘密通道。
要返回这里时，请按下秘密开关。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Items in the Treasure Room
are produced once each day.
Therefore, you must obtain
the treasure items everyday.
For the sake of the guild,
prioritize treasure harvesting!
scripts.translation:
[管家]
宝库每天生成一次物品，因此需要每天取走宝物。
为了公会，请优先处理宝物的收取！

scripts.text:
{0}
There is one Emperium
and two Guardian Stones in
each fortress. These stones
are the first line of defense,
and must be destroyed before
enemies can even enter.

{0}
The stones are located in
^4D4DFFGate Houses^000000 which must be
protected to prevent enemies
from reaching the Emperium.
Guardian Stones can ^4D4DFFrecall
your Guardians^000000 for protection.

{0}
Fortresses with higher levels
of defense can summon more
Guardians: this is why it is
so important for guilds to
invest in Defense Growth.

{0}
Guardian Stones that have
been destroyed can be revived
after a certain time, but one of the guild members must give
me the order. I can also report the status of the Guardian Stones.

{0}
^4D4DFFFortress Gates^000000 are the second line of guild stronghold defense,
and are protected by extra barricades activated by the Guardian Stones.
These gates are located in three different parts of the fortress.

{0}
Barricades are protected by
Guardian Stones, and are
restored when the Guardian
Stones are retrieved. However,
it is not as easy to restore
destroyed Fortress Gates.

{0}
Fortress Gates can only be
restored when the ^4D4DFFguild
master of a stronghold
changes^000000, or if ^4D4DFFrestoration
is requested by the guild
master of the stronghold^000000.
scripts.translation:
{0}
要塞大门只能在^4D4DFF占领要塞的公会会长变更^000000，或^4D4DFF现任公会会长提出修复请求^000000时重建。

scripts.text:
{0}
Strongholds have many
Link Flags that allow you
to access vital areas within
restrictions placed by the
Barricades. Usually, ^4D4DFFFlag 1
links to the Gate House^000000.

{0}
Many flags link directly to
the flag near the Emperium.
The final numbered flag is
linked to the Convenience
Facility of the stronghold's
owner. Keep this in mind.
scripts.translation:
{0}
许多旗帜可以直接传送到华丽金属附近的旗帜。
编号最后的旗帜通往要塞所属公会的便利设施。
请记住这一点。

scripts.text:

and your enemies' weaknesses.
